replies.reasoning: No template is a three-wheeled robot, so build one from scratch; the parking car is the closest template alternative.

ideas.title: Warehouse runner
ideas.world: A warehouse aisle with blue shelving, yellow lane lines and a loading dock
ideas.body: A delivery robot with two driven wheels, a front caster and distance rays
ideas.learns: To drive down the aisle and stop at the loading spot
ideas.outline: Concrete-grey floor, shelving on both sides of a 4 m aisle, a crate in the way, the goal in front of the dock. Body: a 0.6 m chassis on two rear torque-driven wheels and a front caster ball, five distance rays forward.
